Update Android System WebView to use Miss Minutes.
Let her react on her own?
She will show small reactions, an emotion or a gesture and never text or speech, when something happens such as plugging in the charger. You can turn this off at any time.
Share system details with online models?
When you ask her something, the online model you chose may be told which apps you have or your battery and network state. Turn this off to keep them private.
Suggest mode lets her run low-risk helpers such as timers and notes by herself. Anything else still asks you first.
Authorized mode lets her use the permissions you have granted without asking each time, up to 20 automatic actions an hour. Files, commands and messages to other people are not available on Android.
